features: Superior Viewing Experience: Experience 1.77 times more screen detail than FHD with the brilliant clarity and vibrant colour of QHD (2560x1440) resolution, while a 144Hz refresh rate and 1ms Moving Picture Response Time (MPRT) deliver a smooth, tear-free viewing experience.
Exceptional Contrast: 1500:1 contrast ratio for deeper blacks and brighter whites.
Eye Comfort: Prioritise visual comfort with this TÜV Rheinland 3-star display. Reduce harmful blue light emissions and maintain stunning image quality without compromising colours.

Dependable From Every Angle: Wide Viewing Angle- Get consistent views across a wide 178°/178° viewing angle . Ultra-Thin Bezels- Maximise your viewing experience with thin bezels. In-Plane Switching (IPS)- See excellent colour accuracy and consistency across wide angles with In-Plane Switching (IPS) technology. Vivid colours- Wide colour coverage with up to 16.7m displayable colours of 99% sRGB.
